description: This PHP source file provides utility functions for array manipulation, such as converting objects to arrays, deeply comparing arrays, generating PHP code from array values, handling array differences, and extending array access with dot notation. It also includes licensing and legal notices related to SugarCRM and SuiteCRM.

classes.name: SugarArray
classes.description: A wrapper class extending PHP's ArrayObject to provide recursive, dot-notated array key access, allowing for easy retrieval of nested array values.

methods.name: var_export_helper
methods.description: Returns the PHP code representation of an array, preserving empty keys.

methods.name: override_value_to_string
methods.description: Generates PHP code string to override a value in an array variable.

methods.name: add_blank_option
methods.description: Ensures an array has a blank option entry, or creates one if input is not an array.

methods.name: override_value_to_string_recursive
methods.description: Creates array index assignment code recursively for nested arrays.

methods.name: override_recursive_helper
methods.description: Helper for recursive array override string generation.

methods.name: override_value_to_string_recursive2
methods.description: Recursively generates code to assign values to nested array keys with options to skip empty values.

methods.name: object_to_array_recursive
methods.description: Converts an object to an array recursively, including nested objects.

methods.name: deepArrayDiff
methods.description: Compares two arrays deeply and returns differences, supporting nested arrays.

methods.name: setDeepArrayValue
methods.description: Sets a value deep within a nested array based on a compound key with underscores.

methods.name: array_merge_values
methods.description: Merges two arrays element-wise by concatenating string values at corresponding positions if arrays have the same count.

methods.name: array_search_insensitive
methods.description: Searches for a value in an array case-insensitively.

methods.name: fixIndexArrayFormat
methods.description: Standardizes index array strings by trimming whitespace and removing extra spaces around parentheses.
